cells.Values and default: Path to a directory: the root of the model weights tree. The text is used as given. An empty value counts as unset. Unset: the root is `/opt/positron/weights/huggingface`.
cells.Effect: Sets the root directory under which the built-in weights name of a model, such as `<org>/<model>`, is looked up. It applies when a model is loaded with no explicit weights path. The path found is made canonical, and the programs read the model files from it. `--model-path` does not use it. A relative `--model-path` is joined to the fixed root `/opt/positron/weights/huggingface/`. A missing directory logs `Weights not found at the source path: <path>`, and the program stops. In `rinzler`, `GET /v1/info` returns the weights path of each model.

cells.Effect: Replaces the repository root that the program derives from its own path. The resource map (the YAML file that lists FPGA cards and CPU cores per server type) is then searched at `<value>/config/resource-map.yaml`. In a development build of `rinzler` or `runtron`, the default FUSE stats mount directory becomes `<value>/stats`. Search order: `--resource-map`, `resource-map.yaml` in the working directory, this path, installed maps. With Dice, the map comes only from `/opt/positron/config/resource-map.yaml`. `RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH` and `--fuse-mount` override the FUSE path. A development build has `/gen/` in its path. The log shows `INIT: Successfully loaded resource map from <path>`.
